rationale.org-governance: Defines organization-wide policies, roles, training, audits, and incident response.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Operationalizes copyright, licensing, indemnity, and external legal compliance obligations.
rationale.tooling-supply-chain: Requires vetting ACA training data, filters, indemnity, and provider terms.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Embeds deterministic SCA license scanning and blocking into CI/CD pipelines.
rationale.risk-routing: Routes findings by license severity, module criticality, and organizational tolerance.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Authorized audit teams inspect flagged commits and block noncompliant production changes.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Detailed SCA reports support human judgments about violations and corrective actions.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Requires tagging, persistent reports, exception records, SBOMs, and corrective-action trails.
rationale.framework: DevLicOps provides a reusable license-governance architecture integrated across the SDLC.
rationale.design-only: Specifies components and decision procedures without implementation or credible evaluation.
rationale.assistive: Primarily governs human-initiated ACA suggestions accepted during ordinary coding workflows.
rationale.steering: Substantively recommends model selection, fine-tuning, RAG, filtering, and prompt constraints.
rationale.risk-ip: Licensing, copyright, attribution, indemnity, and plagiarism-like regurgitation are focal harms.
rationale.method-self-report: An interview and informal professional discussions provide limited original practitioner evidence.
